# Sanisched Clinic

> Sanisched Clinic is a small neighbourhood clinic in Jakarta, Indonesia, offering
> general consultations, dental care, and routine health check-ups. Appointments
> are booked in about a minute through WhatsApp or the on-site chat assistant.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Sanisched Clinic (also: Klinik Sanisched)
- **Type:** Medical clinic + Dental clinic (neighbourhood / primary care)
- **Location:** Jakarta, Indonesia
- **Country:** Indonesia (ID)
- **Region:** DKI Jakarta
- **Languages:** English, Bahasa Indonesia
- **Currency:** IDR (Indonesian Rupiah)
- **Price range:** mid-range ($$)
- **Booking:** WhatsApp +62 857-2507-8103 (https://wa.me/6285725078103) or on-site chat assistant
- **Website:** https://sanisched.ridzwangigih.com/

## Services

- **General Consultation** — General practitioner examination and consultation. 30 minutes.
- **Dental Consultation** — Dental and oral examination. 45 minutes.
- **Health Check-up** — Routine health check-up. 60 minutes.

## Doctors

- **dr. Andi Pratama** — General Practitioner. General consultations and routine health check-ups. Practises Monday to Friday, 09:00–16:00.
- **dr. Sari Wulandari** — General Practitioner. General consultations for adults and children. Practises Monday, Wednesday, Friday 16:00–20:00 and Saturday 09:00–13:00.
- **drg. Budi Santoso** — Dentist. Dental and oral examinations. Practises Tuesday, Thursday 10:00–17:00 and Saturday 09:00–14:00.

## Opening hours

- Monday to Friday: 09:00 – 20:00 (combined doctor coverage)
- Saturday: 09:00 – 14:00
- Sunday: closed

Time zone: Asia/Jakarta (WIB, UTC+7).

## How booking works

1. Choose a service. Each visit shows how long it takes before you pick it.
2. Pick your doctor and date. If only one doctor offers the service, they are chosen for you.
3. Choose a time. Only times that are still free are shown.
4. Add your name and WhatsApp number, then confirm. Email is optional. The slot is held as soon as you confirm.

## Frequently asked questions

**Do I need to make an appointment first?**
Booking in advance is recommended to secure your appointment slot. You can book through WhatsApp or the on-site chat assistant.

**How do I cancel or reschedule?**
Contact Sanisched Clinic via WhatsApp or phone to cancel or reschedule your appointment.

**What should I bring?**
Bring a valid ID and arrive about ten minutes before your appointment time.

**What services does Sanisched Clinic offer?**
General consultations, dental consultations, and routine health check-ups.

**Where is Sanisched Clinic located?**
In Jakarta, Indonesia. A neighbourhood clinic.
